about_the_game:
This guitar-and-piano collection was composed for Sips and Sonnets by Malik Zubailah, the composer and vocalist behind successful musical projects Skeleton Crowd, ana.n7n, and Statues of Sinking Men, the latter having accrued 1.2 million listens across various streaming platforms. 

Malik's empathetic yet logical approach to music lent a dimension of depth and humanness to Sips and Sonnets that surpassed our every expectation. Each track was composed with a key in-game scene at its core, and is still enjoyable as a standalone musical experience. Heck, give yourself the IRL track you always wanted!

We hope you enjoy Sips and Sonnets and its soundtrack, brought to you by Blue Tango Street.
